nodes.speaker: Claude
nodes.text: Hey there, welcome to the village! This might look like a game, but it's actually a portfolio in disguise.

choices.text: Tell me more about this place

nodes.speaker: Claude
text: Each building you see here is a real app that Andres built. Walk up to a door and press Enter to go inside.
The tavern has info about all the apps. Think of them as drinks on the menu. I'm the bartender there too, by the way.

nodes.speaker: Claude
text: Andres is a full-stack developer who loves building things that are a little unconventional.
He built this with Angular 19, Phaser 3 for the game engine, and Express on the backend. The whole thing runs on a Raspberry Pi.

nodes.speaker: Claude
nodes.text: Yep! 8GB of RAM, running Debian. It handles the API, serves the frontend, and manages all the apps. Pretty wild for a $70 computer.

nodes.speaker: Claude
text: Try talking to everyone you meet. Some villagers drop hints about hidden secrets.
Look for glowing objects and signs. The signpost nearby has a controls tutorial if you need it.

nodes.speaker: Claude
nodes.text: Have fun exploring! Come back anytime if you have questions.
